findings.current: And that day, the young man became a Demon Lord.
findings.defect: 魔軍 refers to a demonic army or force, not the Demon Lord title. The draft gives him a title at this point rather than saying he joined that force.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly writes 魔軍, whereas Demon Lord would require a different character for 군.
findings.replacement: And that day, the young man became part of the demonic army.
findings.source: 그리고 그날, 청년은 마군(魔軍)이 되었다.

findings.defect: The translation drops the gendered insult in 네년.
findings.rationale: His address is contemptuous and specifically directed at a woman, not merely a generic expletive.

findings.current: His Disciple Ma Sanbao and the masters of the Twelve Palaces of the Zodiac, returned from the dead, flanked him on either side
findings.defect: The draft turns one resurrected master into multiple masters.
findings.rationale: 고수를 is singular here; Ma Sanbao and that master occupy the two flanking positions.
findings.replacement: His Disciple Ma Sanbao and a master of the Twelve Palaces of the Zodiac, returned from the dead, flanked him on either side
findings.source: 제자인 마삼보와 죽음에서 부활한 황도십이궁의 고수를 좌우로 거느린 채

findings.current: “Hey, you ugly-ass bastard. If you’re not too busy, spare us a little time.”
findings.defect: “Bastard” replaces the deliberately familiar, mocking 오빠, while “us” adds an addressee-side plural absent from the request.
findings.rationale: The speaker uses a provocative older-brother address alongside strong profanity and asks him to make time.
findings.replacement: “Hey, ugly-ass big bro. If you’re not too busy, make some time for me.”
findings.source: 거기 존나 못생긴 오빠. 많이 안 바쁘면 시간 좀 내주라.

findings.current: “If you bite down on a sword and kill yourself right now, I might consider telling you once.”
findings.defect: “Once” attaches to telling him, rather than to her willingness to consider telling him.
findings.rationale: 한 번 정도는 고민해 볼게 qualifies the consideration, not the number of times she would answer.
findings.replacement: “If you bite down on a sword and kill yourself right now, I might think about telling you.”
findings.source: 지금이라도 칼 물고 자결하면, 그럼 한 번 정도는 고민해 볼게.

summary: The draft is largely faithful, but it changes one affiliation into a title, pluralizes a single fighter, and flattens two pointed forms of address.
